subject: gk
question: When the office of Chairman of the Council of States is vacant, then his or her duties shall be performed by which of the following?

options.text: Speaker of the House of the People
Senior most member of the Council of States
Deputy Chairman of the Council of States

solution:
The correct answer is __**Deputy Chairman of the Council of States**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When the office of the Chairman of the Council of States (Rajya Sabha) is vacant, the duties are performed by the **Deputy Chairman of the Council of States**.
 
• This provision ensures the smooth functioning of the Council of States in the absence of the Chairman.
